label: Adjust blinds
description: Allows for the control of the relative level of a device like a blind or a curtain in step size.

stepShadeLevel.label: Adjust blinds
stepShadeLevel.description: Change the window shade level by the given amount. If the level exceeds the minimum (typically 0) or maximum (typically 100) then it will be clamped to those values.

stepSize.description: The amount to change from current window shade level, usually ``-100 to 100`` in percent
